title: United States and Canada construction class codes
text:
United States and Canada construction class codes

Touchstone
 supports the construction codes
 listed in this topic for the United States and Canada. Each listed code is not necessarily
 supported for both countries.
Solar codes were added, only for the United States, in 
Touchstone
 2025 (13.0).

Note:
 For information about supported codes and limitations for specific
 models, refer to the model documentation available on the 
Client Portal
.
